item.title: The Art of Slow Reading in a Fast World
item.description: Why the best ideas require patience, and how to reclaim your attention from the algorithm.
item.content:encoded:
We've optimized for speed. Infinite scroll, TL;DR summaries, fifteen-second videos, AI-generated summaries of AI-generated summaries. The modern internet treats reading as a throughput problem — how much content can you consume per minute?

But understanding doesn't scale with velocity.

When you read quickly, you're not reading — you're scanning. You're pattern-matching against what you already know, extracting the gist, discarding the texture. The gist is useful for traffic reports and weather forecasts. It's fatal for ideas that change how you think.
item.author: hello@publicblog.example (Alex Chen)
